items.summary: First BanCorp. (the “Corporation”) (NYSE: FBP), the bank holding company for FirstBank Puerto Rico, announced today that Orlando Berges, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will retire from the Corporation effective June 30, 2026, after close to 17 years of distinguished service.
